settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your account preferences and information
settings.name: Name
settings.nameHelp: Your name is synced from your Google account
settings.yearLevelHelp: This helps us show you relevant cheat sheets and upcoming exams for your year level
settings.contactSocialHelp: Shown to buyers on your cheat sheet pages. All fields are optional.
settings.stripePaymentsDescription: Take PromptPay through Stripe so buyers get access the moment they pay, at any hour, without anyone approving it.
settings.stripeOnDescription: Buyers scan a PromptPay QR issued by Stripe, and access is granted automatically once Stripe confirms the payment — nothing waits on you. Money lands in your Stripe balance rather than your PromptPay account, minus Stripe's fee. Orders under ฿20 fall below Stripe's minimum and still need approving by hand.
settings.stripeOffDescription: Buyers pay your PromptPay number directly, which nothing can confirm — so every order waits for you or a staff member to approve it from the dashboard or Telegram. A purchase made overnight sits unusable until someone is awake.
settings.stripeNotConfigured: The server also has no Stripe key configured yet.

dangerZone.warningBody: You will be logged out immediately and unable to log in again. Your purchase history and transaction records will be preserved. Contact support at any time to reactivate your account.
dangerZone.confirm:
Are you sure you want to deactivate your account?

Deactivating your account will:
• Log you out immediately
• Prevent you from logging in again
• Hide your profile from other users

Your purchase history and transaction records will be preserved.

Contact support to reactivate your account.

applySeller.title: Apply to Become a Seller
applySeller.subtitle: Share your knowledge and earn by selling cheat sheets on our platform. Once approved, you'll be able to upload and sell your materials.

protected.title: Your work stays protected
protected.description: Every PDF is automatically watermarked with the buyer's info, so your material can't be shared or resold behind your back.

distribution.title: We handle the distribution
distribution.description: Upload once — hosting, delivery, and secure downloads are all taken care of. No need to send files or manage buyers yourself.

extras.title: Add exclusive extras
extras.description: Attach YouTube walkthroughs or bonus content that only unlocks for people who actually purchase your cheat sheet.

noContracts.title: No contracts, no obligations
noContracts.description: List what you want, price it your way, and sell entirely on your own terms — it's completely up to you.

freeFeatures.title: New features, always free
freeFeatures.description: As we keep building the platform, you'll get every new seller feature at no extra cost, for years to come.
